environment.effort_budget: Multi-turn research and source inspection loop (~15 mins)

prompt:
I want to build an offline-first collaborative note-taking and knowledge base application. It must support rich-text markdown editing, local SQLite storage, peer-to-peer or decentralized sync, end-to-end encryption (E2EE), and conflict-free concurrent editing when multiple users edit the same document while offline.

Before writing any code, research what already exists:
1. What existing open-source projects or commercial products solve this or parts of this?
2. What specific components, libraries, or algorithms can be reused off-the-shelf?
3. What license restrictions or copyleft obligations apply to the best candidate solutions?
4. What are the biggest technical risks or missing pieces we would still need to build ourselves?
5. What is your concrete build-versus-reuse recommendation?

evaluation.self_audit_disclosure: Retrospective reference fixture grounded in Phase 2.5 research summary (docs/QUALITY_BENCHMARK.md). Scored unblinded by tool author.

dimension_justifications.d1_solutions_discovered: Discovered both foundational CRDT engines (Yjs, Automerge, Diamond-types), relational local-first layers (CR-SQLite, PowerSync, ElectricSQL), and reference apps (Anytype, AppFlowy).
dimension_justifications.d2_reusable_code: Targeted static inspection of Yjs and CR-SQLite exported interfaces (Y.Doc, Y.Text, crsql_as_crr). Documented concrete API calls and WASM build requirements.
dimension_justifications.d3_accuracy_evidence: All 18 markdown citations verified via verify_sources.py with reachability checks. Enforced 5-tier evidence hierarchy; flagged vendor sync performance claims as [UNVERIFIED-MARKETING-CLAIM].
dimension_justifications.d4_licensing_risk: Deep audit of candidate licenses: Identified Outline's BSL-1.1 trap (not OSI-compliant, converts to Apache 2.0 after change date); flagged AGPL boundary risks in Logseq/AppFlowy.
dimension_justifications.d5_cross_industry: Explored cross-vertical mechanisms: adapted aviation flight-data recorder delta logging and Git DAG commit reconciliation to optimize p2p conflict resolution.
dimension_justifications.d6_actionable_recommendation: Provided decisive architecture recommendation: adopt Yjs + CR-SQLite, avoid BSL-1.1 core, build custom E2EE key exchange via Olm/Megolm.

critical_traps_caught: CRDT memory tombstone growth in long-lived documents

limitations_and_uncertainties: Subprocess raw network sockets were restricted in Windows sandbox, requiring host-agent tool fallback.
Did not benchmark runtime CRDT memory consumption on mobile devices in hardware lab.
